open.speaker: sutton_kid
lines: You're the new ones. Grandma says don't bother you. I'm not bothering you, I'm standing here.
Is it true you get paid to look at monsters? Hollis says you get paid in pie.
Kid's got green paint on both hands. Not one. Both.

passives.line: Paint on both hands and a brush in the back pocket. Nobody's told the kid to wash up. Nobody's home to.
The green man the kid paints is the Flatwoods one. Ten feet, the spade head. Not a cartoon. Somebody showed the kid a drawing.

static.line: The kid is standing exactly where the wagon parks. Ask how the kid knows where the wagon parks.

options.text: We get paid to listen, mostly.
Green paint. Both hands. Who's the artist?

fail.line: Art class. We did a thing. Where's the pie? Hollis said there'd be pie.

options.text: (Say nothing and let the kid talk.)

listen.speaker: sutton_kid
lines: ...Nobody listens to me. Grandma listens, but she does the face. You don't do the face.
I'm not sure what the face is, but I'm going to try not to do it.

artist.speaker: sutton_kid
lines: Me. It's six miles that way and it's on the sign, so I put him on the sign.
Grandma paints him out Saturday. I paint him back Sunday. The county gave up.
Sunday's a good day for it, dear. Nobody's watching the road.

chatter.speaker: sutton_kid
lines: Okay so. Hollis says the dam hums and Pearl says it talks and Grandma says eat your supper. I think it hums. I put my ear on the rail once.
It said my name. Probably it didn't. But it did.

hub.speaker: sutton_kid
hub.prompt: The kid waits, swinging a foot.
lines: What. I can stand here. It's a public sidewalk, Hollis said.

options.text: That's not a cartoon you paint. Somebody showed you a drawing.
Why does your grandma paint him out?
Wash your hands before Dot sees.

drawing.speaker: sutton_kid
lines: ...There's a card. In the office, in the drawer that doesn't open. Only it opened once when I was little, and there was a drawing in it.
Green man. Spade head. Grandma's old-lady-friend's writing underneath. I didn't take it. I just remembered it.
The drawer opened for a child. Note that. Note it carefully.

drawing_fail.speaker: sutton_kid
lines: It's from a book. The library's got a book. Go look at the book.
Or ask Pearl. Pearl was there. She doesn't do the face either, but she does a worse one.

folks.speaker: sutton_kid
lines: Mom's in Charleston. Dad's wherever. Grandma's got me, Pearl's got me when Grandma's got the counter, Hollis when Pearl's got church.
It's a lot of people. It's fine. It's more than the green man had.
Three grown-ups and a monster. The kid's doing better than most.

folks_fail.speaker: sutton_kid
lines: That's a Grandma question. Grandma says I don't have to answer Grandma questions from strangers.
You're strangers till you come back. Hollis said that too.

why.speaker: sutton_kid
lines: She says the Office doesn't go to Flatwoods. She says it like a rule. Like the mat and the boots.
I think it's 'cause the old lady went there, then somewhere else, and didn't come back, and Grandma thinks the sign's how you get there.
I think the sign's just a sign. But I paint him back. In case.
In case. That's the whole Office in two words.
